flow.name: panchang_day_context
flow.input: Asia/Kolkata civil publication date + separately approved canonical editorial Panchang context basis; never the requesting user's location or local sunrise day
flow.output: Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, Paksha, Vara, festival/observance/theme context

flow.name: morphology_engine
flow.output: possible Sanskrit forms/roots/stems/valid forms from sourced lexical records

flow.name: semantics_engine
flow.output: meaning, semantic range, usage boundary, reflective sense

flow.name: primary_or_fallback_selection
flow.input: source/language/editorial-approved applicable candidate pool + approved context/precedence references + complete governed publication/reservation history
flow.output: unused eligible candidates only; approved lexical fallback records cannot bypass identity/exhaustion protection, and no missing-data fallback may be manufactured

flow.name: duplicate_control
flow.input: unused eligible pool + reviewed canonical identity/equivalence links + compatible repeat-window exclusions + approved deterministic precedence
flow.output: one auditable proposed assignment or a structured withheld reason; never automatic least-recent reuse

flow.name: datewise_result_saving
flow.input: version-bound assignment proposal + complete history revision + atomic uniqueness/identity reservation checks
flow.output: append-only draft reservation, approved assignment and publication events under the policy history contract; same-date replay preserves the existing assignment
